title: Precise plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle system based on machine vision
abstract: The invention discloses a precise plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle system based on machine vision, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles. The unmanned aerial vehicle has the beneficial effects that the unmanned aerial vehicle body, the precise spraying holder carried below the unmanned aerial vehicle body, the flight control system and the visual recognition system are arranged, precise recognition and fixed-point spraying are achieved during use, machine vision and the two-degree-of-freedom spraying holder are combined, pests and diseases can be precisely attacked, and the spraying efficiency is improved. The traditional large-area and undifferentiated spraying mode is thoroughly changed; as only the identified pest and disease damage area is sprayed, the environmental pollution caused by pesticide abuse is effectively reduced, and the farmland ecology is protected; a distributed architecture is adopted, flight control and holder control are separated, mutual interference between system tasks is avoided, and the flight stability of the unmanned aerial vehicle during execution of complex recognition and spraying tasks is guaranteed.

title: AR SYSTEM FOR OPERATING NON-VISUAL DRONE MISSION APPLYING AR AND METHOD USING THEREOF
abstract: According to the present invention, a system for operating a mission system using a drone comprises: AR glass outputting drone flight information and a way point through augmented reality based on a drone photographed image; a monitoring device outputting the drone photographed image and mission plan information based on a map; and a control device generating mission performance data using a satellite map and the drone photographed image and transmitting the mission performance data to the monitoring device.

title: METHODS AND APPARATUS FOR NAVIGATION WITH POINT MASS FILTERS
abstract: Methods and apparatus for navigation with point mass filters are disclosed. A disclosed apparatus to adjust a probabilistic grid of a point mass filter for navigation of a vehicle includes interface circuitry communicatively coupled to a sensor of the vehicle, machine readable instructions, and programmable circuitry to at least one of instantiate or execute the machine readable instructions to move the probabilistic grid based on movement of the vehicle, and perform a linear adjustment of at least a portion of the probabilistic grid with respect to time based on a bounded error corresponding to the movement of the vehicle.

title: DISRUPTION TO AN OPERATION OF AN UNMANNED AERIAL VEHICLE
abstract: A method for disrupting communication over a communication link used by an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV). The method may include: detecting a communication, over the communication link, between the UAV and another user of the communication link; and transmitting, over the communication link multiple superfluous messages related to access control of the communication link thereby disrupting the communication over the communication link.

title: Recipient customized delivery paths for unmanned aerial vehicle deliveries
abstract: Methods, systems and computer program products for creating customized delivery paths for unmanned aerial vehicle deliveries are provided. Aspects include receiving, from a delivery recipient, one or more delivery locations for a delivery of a package and receiving, from the delivery recipient, a flight plan associated with each of the one or more delivery locations, wherein at least one of the flight plans include an authorized path across a private property. Aspects also include receiving, from the delivery recipient, a set of delivery recipient preferences that are used to determine which of the one or more delivery locations should be used to deliver the package and storing, by a processor in a computer readable medium, the set of delivery recipient preferences for use in determining a delivery location for a package to the delivery recipient.

title: Insulator zero value detection device
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of insulator detection, and provides an insulator zero value detection device which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, a servo rotating platform is arranged in a carrying frame of the unmanned aerial vehicle body, a mounting base is fixedly mounted on a rotating disc of the servo rotating platform, and a pitching plate is mounted on the mounting base through a pitching adjusting mechanism. The pitching plate is provided with a telescopic plate through a telescopic adjusting mechanism, the pitching plate is also provided with an image real-time return mechanism, the telescopic plate is provided with a rotating plate through a rotating adjusting mechanism, the rotating plate is provided with two detection probes through a discharge gap adjusting mechanism, and the detection ends of the two detection probes have a distance matched with the width of an insulator. Zero-value detection of the insulator is realized through unmanned aerial vehicle carrying and remote control, an operator does not need to climb a tower for operation, the labor intensity is reduced, the operation safety is ensured, no special requirement on the insulation performance of the device exists, the operation is simple and flexible, and the detection efficiency and the detection accuracy of the insulator can be effectively improved.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle safe landing device in limited space
abstract: The invention relates to the field of water conservancy and hydropower engineering, and particularly discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle safe landing device in the limited space. The unmanned aerialvehicle comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body and landing rods. The landing rods are symmetrically and fixedly connected to the two sides of the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle body; Landingsupporting frames are fixedly connected to the lower portion of the landing rods and each comprises an expansion foot stand, a T-shaped frame, an I-shaped frame and two rectangular frames. The expansion foot stands are fixedly connected to the front portion and the rear portion of the lower section of each rectangular frame, and a plurality of LED lamps are fixedly connected to the front portionof the landing rod and the front section of each rectangular frame. The contact area between the unmanned aerial vehicle and the ground is increased through the landing supporting frames additionallyarranged at the bottom so that the unmanned aerial vehicle can land more stably under the condition of a closed space with disordered airflow, and an air crash accident is prevented.

title: Uncontrolled type strategy fuel consumption fuel tank suitable for supersonic unmanned aerial vehicle and unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract: The invention provides an uncontrolled type strategy fuel consumption fuel tank suitable for a supersonic unmanned aerial vehicle and the unmanned aerial vehicle. The uncontrolled type strategy fuel consumption fuel tank suitable for the supersonic unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a head fuel tank, a middle fuel tank and a tail fuel tank, all of which are sequentially arranged in the direction front a nose to a tail of the unmanned aerial vehicle; and the head fuel tank, the middle fuel tank and the tail fuel tank are sequentially connected in series, the head fuel tank is provided with a pressurization pipe, the tail fuel tank is provided with a fuel supply pipe, when the unmanned aerial vehicle flies, the fuel supply pipe supplies fuel, the head fuel tank is pressurized through a pressurization port, and fuel tank set series-connection fuel consumption is achieved. By the adoption of the provided uncontrolled type strategy fuel consumption fuel tank suitable for the supersonic unmanned aerial vehicle and the unmanned aerial vehicle, a fuel tank set series-connection fuel consumption strategy is used, the volume of each sub fuel tank is optimized according to the task profile, sothat the ultrahigh static stability of supersonic flight is properly reduced, and the purposes that trim drag is reduced and the flight performance of the unmanned aerial vehicle is improved are achieved.

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR TRACKING BEAN USING GAUSSIAN PROCESS
abstract: The technology discloses a system and a method for beam tracking using the Gaussian processor. According to a specific implementation example of the technology, as an optimal beamforming vector is derived based on prediction location information of a user terminal learned from the Gaussian processor and predetermined location information of a base station, it is possible to reduce the computational complexity regarding the prediction location information of the user terminal, and accordingly, the versatility of an unmanned aerial vehicle tracking system can be fundamentally improved; and the accuracy of the prediction location information of the user terminal is fundamentally improved, such that it is possible to derive an optimized beamforming vector with maximum spectral efficiency, thereby improving the performance of the system.

title: MOVING VEHICLE FOR LAND AND AIR DELIVERY
abstract: A moving body for delivery on the ground comprises an air moving body and a land moving body.the air moving body delivers a delivery product in the air, forms a transfer space with the ground, and lands.the land moving body delivers the delivery product on the ground, enters the transfer space, and delivers or receives the delivery product.in this case, the land moving body comprises a driving module.the driving module is located at a first height when entering the transfer space, and rises to a second height higher than the first height when delivering or receiving the delivery product.

title: Public safety priority-oriented low-altitude logistics unmanned aerial vehicle safety buffer system
abstract: The invention provides a low-altitude logistics unmanned aerial vehicle safety buffer system oriented to public safety priority, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle safety protection, and the low-altitude logistics unmanned aerial vehicle safety buffer system is characterized in that a safety cabin covers the outer part of a low-altitude logistics unmanned aerial vehicle body; the public acquisition unit is arranged below the safety cabin and is used for scanning and analyzing an application scene to obtain public condition information; the intelligent control unit is associated with a control center of the low-altitude logistics unmanned aerial vehicle, when the low-altitude logistics unmanned aerial vehicle falls, artificial intelligence analysis is carried out according to the state information of the low-altitude logistics unmanned aerial vehicle and public condition information, and an energy absorption regulation and control instruction is determined; and the external collapsing frame is arranged outside the safety cabin in a surrounding manner through a plurality of controllable collapsing components, and support regulation and control are performed according to the energy absorption regulation and control instruction so as to realize dissipation of target energy. The impact energy is dissipated according to the public safety priority principle, the impact of the low-altitude logistics unmanned aerial vehicle on the public on the ground is relieved, and the public potential safety hazards are reduced.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle with angle adjusting mechanism for surveying and mapping real scene
abstract: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle with an angle adjusting mechanism for surveying and mapping a real scene, and relates to the field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and the unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a camera arranged below a shell of the unmanned aerial vehicle. The power assembly is arranged in the working cavity, oil in the oil storage chamber can be conveyed to the first rotating assembly and the second rotating assembly in a small-amount conveying mode each time through the electromagnet and the magnet arranged in the power assembly, and therefore the magnetic repulsion principle is utilized; the oil in the sealed space is extruded to push the camera to rotate and adjust in the vertical direction or the horizontal direction, and the camera is pushed to rotate and adjust by using the oil; the camera has the advantages of improving the rotating precision of the camera, lubricating a rotating bearing on the camera, enabling the camera to steer stably, reducing abrasion of the rotating bearing so as to eliminate vibration force, reducing the vibration force through oil driving, cooling the position of the bearing, prolonging the service life of the bearing, resisting falling and wind, and avoiding serious abrasion caused by overlarge stress on the bearing.

title: SUBMINIATURE IMAGE CAMERA MODULE FOR DRONE
abstract: The present invention provides a subminiature image camera module for a drone having an optimized function as an image camera for a drone. The subminiature image camera module comprises: an image sensor for obtaining a stopped image and an image sensor for obtaining a moving image; an image storage unit storing the images obtained from the image sensors; a wireless image transmission interface module wirelessly transmitting the obtained images from the image sensors to an external control system in real time; and an image processing module enhancing a low luminance image among images obtained from the image sensors.

title: Systems and methods for synchronizing events in shifted temporal reference systems
abstract: A system for synchronizing events has a first subsystem that detects, measures, or generates a first set of events and the first subsystem has a first clock for time-stamping each event detected, measured, or generated by the first subsystem. The system further has a second subsystem that detects, measures, or generates a second set of events and the second subsystem has a second clock not synchronized to the first clock. The second clock is for time-stamping events detected, measured, or generated by the second subsystem. The first set of events is related to the second set of events. The system further has a processor that correlates the first set of events with the second set of events to determine a value indicative of a temporal shift between a time of occurrence of the first set of events and a time of occurrence of the second set of events. Also, the processor temporally matches the first set of events to the second set of events and outputs data indicative of the matching between the first set of events to the second set of events to an output device.

title: DELIVERY SYSTEM, FLYING BODY, AND CONTROLLER
abstract: To deliver a cargo in a stable posture.SOLUTION: A deliver system 1 includes a flying body 100 on which a cargo 50 can be loaded, and a controller 160 that controls the operation of the flying body 100 so as to deliver the cargo 50 from a departure point 3 to a target point 5. The flying body 100 has an outer pipe and an inner pipe stored in the outer pipe, has a frame body 20 made from a plurality of struts capable of expanding/contracting in an axial direction, and another frame body 10 having a loading surface 15 for loading the cargo 50 is coupled to a lower portion of the frame body 20. A body portion 30 having a flying mechanism 31 is provided on an upper portion of the frame body 20. The flying body 100 includes a control portion 60A executing flying posture control for controlling the expansion/contraction of the plurality of struts for controlling a flying posture of an object, and frying control for controlling the actuation of the flying mechanism, and a first communication portion 60B for radio-communicating with the controller 160. The controller 160 includes a second communicating portion 160A for radio-communicating with the flying body 100.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Dust collecting apparatus that can remove suspended dust in air
abstract: Disclosed is a dust collector capable of removing suspended dust that rarely requires repair and maintenance. A dust collector capable of removing suspended dust according to the present invention includes a housing in which an inlet through which air including suspended dust is introduced is formed in the front side, and an atmosphere in which the suspended dust is filtered is discharged through an air outlet in the rear side; a rotary filter that is rotatably installed inside the housing so that the suspended dust is filtered and collected in the front, and the floating dust is separated and desorbed from the rear; and a sealing structure fixed between the inner wall of the housing and the rotary filter so that the atmosphere flows in from the inlet of the housing and then passes through the rotary filter.

title: Mobile transportation means for transporting data collectors, data collection system and data collection method
abstract: A mobile transportation apparatus for transporting at least one data collector to at least one data collection position has at least one set-down apparatus for setting down the data collector at the data collection position and at least one receiving apparatus for receiving data which the data collector transmits to the transportation apparatus. Accordingly, a data collection system has at least one mobile transportation apparatus and at least one data collector. In a data collection method, at least one data collector is transported to at least one data collection position by way of at least one mobile transportation apparatus and is set down at the said data collection position by a set-down apparatus of the transportation apparatus, the data collector which is arranged at the data collection position collects data, and the collected data is transmitted to the transportation apparatus by the data collector.

title: Anti-falling unmanned aerial vehicle for pesticide spraying
abstract: The invention provides an anti-falling pesticide spraying unmanned aerial vehicle which comprises a main machine assembly, a supporting mechanism and a spraying mechanism, the main machine assembly comprises a clamping piece mechanism, bottom arc blocks are installed on the periphery of the top of a bottom plate of the clamping piece mechanism, top arc blocks are installed on the periphery of the bottom of a top plate of the clamping piece mechanism, and a round hole is formed between the bottom arc blocks and the top arc blocks; a waterproof bin is installed on one side in the clamping mechanism, a flight control system and an external module adapter plate are installed in the waterproof bin, a power distribution plate and a power module are installed on the opposite face of the waterproof bin, a battery is installed at the top of the clamping mechanism, a main machine cover is installed at the top of the battery, and a medicine kettle is installed at the bottom of the clamping mechanism. A filter screen is installed in the liquid medicine kettle opening, the top of the liquid medicine kettle opening is in threaded connection with a liquid medicine cover, and the flight control system plays an important role in the stability of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the reliability, the accuracy, the real-time performance and the like of data transmission and plays a decisive role in the flight performance of the unmanned aerial vehicle.

title: Method and system for delivering goods and retrieving reusable totes for drone delivery
abstract: A delivery system includes a drone including a prime mover, one or more rotors operatively connected to the prime mover, and a payload attachment system including a latch mechanism having a first selectively deployable clamp member and a second selectively deployable clamp member. The delivery system also includes a plurality of nested reusable totes. Each of the plurality of nested reusable totes includes a body having a base, sides, and a lid, at least two of the sides include a gripping feature. The selectively deployable clamp members are operable to engage with the gripping feature on one or more of the plurality of nested reusable totes.

title: Detection system and detection method for pollutant discharge in torch combustion
abstract: The invention relates to a detection system and detection method for pollutant discharge in torch combustion. According to the invention, an aircraft is used for carrying a detection apparatus to detect and acquire torch discharge data, so a detection position can be accurately controlled, and the detection apparatus can reach an aerial position that common measurement apparatuses cannot reach. The invention also provides the method for accurate detection of torch discharge. The accurate value of discharged VOCs can be obtained by calculating detection results of a detector for VOCs, so reliable detection equipment and bases are provided for formulation of corresponding standards for atmospheric pollution of torch discharge; and the aircraft is connected with a steel frame for a torch through a steel pull wire, so the aircraft is prevented from falling and fire ignition when having a fault.

title: Agricultural unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract: The invention discloses an agricultural unmanned aerial vehicle. The agricultural unmanned aerial vehicle comprises an aerial vehicle body in a circular truncated cone shape, flying wings and a connecting ring; one ends of the flying wings are fixedly connected to the outer side wall of the aerial vehicle body, the other ends of the flying wings extend outwards in the radial direction of the aerial vehicle body, and at least three flying wings are arranged in the circumferential direction of the aerial vehicle body at equal intervals; flying propellers are installed at the upper ends at the other ends of the flying wings, and the connecting ring is arranged below the aerial vehicle body and sequentially connected with the bottom ends of the flying wings in the circumferential direction to form a closed ring. A cavity for containing pesticide to be sprayed is formed in the aerial vehicle body, the lower end of the cavity is communicated with a nozzle, and a high-pressure pump is arranged in the nozzle and capable of spraying the pesticide out of the nozzle. The agricultural unmanned aerial vehicle is high in stability and spray efficiency and capable of spraying the pesticide to crops or Chinese herbs on a precipitous mountain conveniently and fast.

title: SYSTEM FOR SUPPORTING AND STABILIZING AN EXTERNAL APPARATUS
abstract: The invention relates to a system (100) for supporting and stabilizing an external apparatus, comprising a stabilizing body (112, 113) surmounted by a support (114) configured to support the apparatus and comprising: - a telescopic pole (116) comprising a part (116a1-116a8) which is deployable manually out of the body along a first vertical pole axis (Z) and having an end for contact with a contact surface or an external device, - N motorized groups (N≥4) for compensating for the position of the system that are configured such that at least two motorized groups are arranged along a second motor axis perpendicular to the first pole axis (Z), and oriented in opposite directions along the second axis, and such that at least two motorized groups are arranged along a third motor axis perpendicular to the first pole axis (Z) and to the second motor axis, and oriented in opposite directions along the third axis.

title: Wing locking device of unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle wing locking device which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle wing assembly, the unmanned aerial vehicle wing assembly is locked and fixed to an unmanned aerial vehicle arm assembly through a wing locking assembly, and the unmanned aerial vehicle arm assembly is locked through the wing locking assembly. A wing unfolding type locking structure or a wing unlocking type self-folding structure is formed between the unmanned aerial vehicle wing assembly and the unmanned aerial vehicle arm assembly, whether the unmanned aerial vehicle wing is installed and locked in place or not can be seen according to the state of the unmanned aerial vehicle wing, specifically, when the wing is unfolded, the unmanned aerial vehicle wing is in the locked-in-place state, and the unmanned aerial vehicle wing is locked in place. When the wings are folded, the wings of the unmanned aerial vehicle are in an unlocked state and locked, locking and fixing of the wings of the unmanned aerial vehicle and synchronous unfolding of the wings of the unmanned aerial vehicle can be achieved in a one-inserting and one-screwing mode, and unlocking of the wings of the unmanned aerial vehicle and synchronous self-folding of the wings of the unmanned aerial vehicle can be achieved in a one-gripping and one-screwing mode during unlocking.

title: magnetic takeoff and landing type drone device
abstract: The present invention provides a magnetic takeoff and landing drone device which takes off and lands on a helipad made of a soft magnetic material to increase safety during takeoff and landing. The magnetic takeoff and landing drone device comprises: a drone body having a body portion and a connection portion; a plurality of landing support portions each having a support body portion connected to the drone body and a support extension portion extending downward from the support body portion; a plurality of electropermanent magnet portions connected to the landing support portions, and having electropermanent magnets provided to selectively generate a magnetic force to be magnetic; an ultrasonic sensor provided under the drone body and measuring a distance from the helipad; and a takeoff and landing control unit comparing, with a preset value, the distance between the drone body and the helipad measured by the ultrasonic sensor, and performing control such that a voltage can be selectively applied to the electropermanent magnet portions.

title: Early warning method and device for unmanned aerial vehicle and unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract: The invention discloses an early warning method and device for an unmanned aerial vehicle and the unmanned aerial vehicle, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining ambient light data collected by an ambient light detection sensor on the unmanned aerial vehicle; judging whether the unmanned aerial vehicle is in a dark environment according to the ambient light data; if yes, controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to enter a dark early warning mode to prompt the position of the unmanned aerial vehicle; when it is detected that the unmanned aerial vehicle is in the dark environment, the unmanned aerial vehicle is controlled to enter the dark early warning mode to prompt the position of the unmanned aerial vehicle, so that when the unmanned aerial vehicle is used in the dark environment, related danger early warning can be carried out, nearby personnel can be prompted about the position of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the situation of collision is avoided, and the personal safety of a user is guaranteed.

title: UNMANNED MOBILE CONTROL DEVICE, UNMANNED MOBILE CONTROL METHOD, UNMANNED MOBILE SYSTEM
abstract: The purpose of the present invention is to enlarge a range where an unmanned mobile body can be remotely operated. A user can remotely control a master drone D0 and control the flying of the master drone D0 by operating a user-side unit (10) to transmit a signal. The user performs an operation for controlling a slave drone D1 through the user-side unit (10), and the user-side unit (10) transmits a signal therefor. A master drone-side unit (20) mounted on the master drone (D0) receives the signal, instead of the slave drone (D1). The slave drone (D1) is controlled by the master drone-side unit (20) that has received the signal. In this manner, the user can control all drones by operating the user-side unit (10).

title: UNMANNED FLIGHT ELECTROSCOPE
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an unmanned flight electroscope capable of quickly preforming electroscope detection for an electroscope target at a low cost.SOLUTION: An unmanned flight electroscope comprises: an unmanned flight body 10 having a control device 14 that controls flight by radio control through a controller 20; and an electroscope 15 which is mounted on the unmanned flight body 10, performs electroscope detection of an electroscope target including a charging part of a transmission line tower 100, and transmits an electroscope result by radio. When receiving the electroscope result from the electroscope 15, the controller 20 outputs the electroscope result.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle aerial wireless energy complementing aircraft
abstract: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle aerial wireless energy complementing aircraft, and belongs to the technical field of novel aircrafts, the unmanned aerial vehicle aerial wireless energy complementing aircraft comprises a double-body aircraft, the double-body aircraft comprises two inflatable airships and a lifting body fuselage, and the inflatable airships are connected through the lifting body fuselage; the propelling systems comprise electric duct propelling systems and oil-driven duct propelling systems, the electric duct propelling systems are arranged on the two sides of each inflatable airship, and the oil-driven duct propelling systems are arranged at the tail of each inflatable airship; the power supply system comprises a solar power generation system, a power generation system and a storage battery, and the solar power generation system is installed on the upper surface of the inflatable airship of the double-body aircraft; the wireless energy complementing system comprises a laser energy transfer system, a microwave energy transfer system and a magnetic coupling energy transfer system, the laser energy transfer system comprises a laser energy charging pod which is hung on the lower surface of the lifting body, and the microwave energy transfer system comprises an electromagnetic transmitting antenna array surface; the lifting body and the skin of the lifting body are conformally arranged and installed on the rear side of the lower surface of the lifting body.

title: Propel machine of universe drone
abstract: The present invention is to provide a thruster that can use a drone with electric power in space without air. The present invention relates to a thruster, which generates propulsive force by deflecting and biased rotation when a rotating body rotates, and can be mounted on a drone to create a drone that can be used in space with electric power.

title: Stealth aircraft for cold air injection
abstract: The invention discloses a stealth aircraft for cold air injection. A semi-olivary aircraft body is also taken as an aircraft wing, and an expanding wing (which extends outwards and inclines around) is added to the aircraft body, so that the reflection of electromagnetic waves is reduced to the maximum extent; fluidic power ducts of positive and negative impellers are driven for cold air injection backwards by virtue of an internal combustion engine, so that the ultraviolet radiation is reduced to the maximum extent; and therefore, stealth is realized.

title: Automatic detector for buildings and structures
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of building structure detection, in particular to a building structure automatic detector which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle assembly. The installation frame is located on the lower side of the unmanned aerial vehicle assembly, a camera shooting assembly and an infrared assembly are installed on the installation frame, and a pressure meter and a sampling assembly are further installed in the installation frame; the first suction cup assemblies on the two sides are mounted on the two sides of the mounting frame; the two second suction cup assemblies are located on the two sides of the mounting frame, and lifting assemblies are mounted between the second suction cup assemblies and the mounting frame; the control assembly is provided with a storage module, and the control assembly is electrically connected with the camera shooting assembly, the infrared assembly, the pressure meter, the sampling assembly, the first suction cup assembly, the second suction cup assembly and the lifting assembly.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle convenient to replace and spray paint
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to an unmanned aerial vehicle convenient for paint replacement, which comprises a paint spraying unmanned aerial vehicle body, an unmanned aerial vehicle body, a motor arranged on the unmanned aerial vehicle body, a propeller arranged on the motor, and a paint spraying piece arranged on the unmanned aerial vehicle body, the connecting piece is arranged between the paint spraying piece and the unmanned aerial vehicle body; the landing platform comprises a transmission assembly arranged below the unmanned aerial vehicle body and a triggering assembly arranged in the transmission assembly. According to the unmanned aerial vehicle convenient for paint spraying replacement, the landing platform is adopted for paint spraying replacement, the working efficiency is remarkably improved, the task execution time is shortened, and faster and more efficient paint spraying service is provided for users.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle targeted precise pesticide application system and pesticide application method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle targeted precise pesticide application system and a pesticide application method thereof. The system comprises a rotor unmanned aerial vehicle and a fixed rack; the rack is provided with a power supply module, a gas-liquid control module and a liquid supply module; an ultrasonic pneumatic spray head pose adjusting module is arranged at the end part of a rotor wing rod piece of the rotor wing unmanned aerial vehicle and is used for adjusting the circumferential rotation and up-and-down pitching poses of an ultrasonic pneumatic spray head; the liquid supply module is used for supplying liquid medicine to the ultrasonic pneumatic spray head arranged on the position and posture adjusting module; the gas-liquid control module is used for supplying air pressure to the ultrasonic pneumatic nozzle and controlling the liquid amount and the spraying speed; a crop information acquisition module is arranged on a rotor wing rod piece of the rotor wing unmanned aerial vehicle and is used for acquiring crop information; and the power supply module is used for supplying power to the rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, the gas-liquid control module, the liquid supply module, the ultrasonic pneumatic nozzle pose adjusting module and the crop information acquisition module. The system can improve the effective utilization rate of pesticides.

title: INNER GUIDE DRONE AND METHOD OF CONTROLLING THAT
abstract: The present invention relates to a drone. More specifically, the present invention relates to a drone for indoor guidance and a control method thereof, capable of guiding a user inside a building to a destination. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the drone for indoor guidance and the control method thereof can guide a user to a destination safely even inside a school or a large building. The drone usually performs indoor air purification and toxic substance detecting functions, and performs guidance to make emergency treatment for indoor users possible when an emergency situation occurs.

title: MOBILE-DRIVEN DRONE
abstract: A mobile-driven drone that consists of motors with propellers, controlled by a microcontroller, which is driven by a battery. The microcontroller can control the motors and their speed. It has a UART interface for communication with smartphone placed on drone acting as a communication channel and provides various sensors like accelerometer, GPS etc. This smart mobile phone acts as a transceiver on the drone, which has the capability to be controlled remotely through its cellular network and applications running on the phone.

title: Monitoring method of complex and dangerous scene and corresponding monitoring system
abstract: The invention discloses a monitoring method of a complex and dangerous scene and a corresponding monitoring system. The method comprises the following steps: performing the monitoring by using a way of combining an unmanned vehicle with a multi-wing unmanned plane, realizing the through by using the unmanned vehicle carrying the multi-wing unmanned plane for the unmanned vehicle reachable scene, and performing the monitoring by using an onboard monitoring device; performing the monitoring by using the multi-wing unmanned plane to fly and using the onboard monitoring device for the unmanned vehicle unreachable scene, wherein the multi-wing unmanned plane performs the positioning communication with the unmanned vehicle to realize the landing on the unmanned vehicle. The invention further provides the system for realizing above-mentioned method. By using the monitoring method disclosed by the invention, the problems that the unmanned plane is deficient in cruising ability and a wireless signal is easy to lose can be effectively solved, the continuous operation in larger region can be realized, the environment obstruction is overcome, and more monitoring information can be acquired.

title: Ducted fan with high thrust-weight ratio
abstract: The invention discloses a ducted fan with a high thrust-weight ratio. The ducted fan comprises a ducted front skin, a ducted rear skin, a supporting guide vane, an annular bulkhead, a paddle assembly, a fairing and a driving system. Wherein the duct front skin and the duct rear skin are connected through the annular bulkhead to form a duct main body; the driving system is installed in the fairing, and the fairing is located on a middle shaft of the duct and connected with the annular bulkhead through a supporting guide vane. The paddle assembly is installed on the front edge of the fairing. The ducted fan has the high thrust-weight ratio, the paddle assemblies can bear higher tension, and the ducted fan is high in performance, easy to maintain and suitable for various application scenes.

title: Solar-powered amphibious migration diving-probing unmanned aerial vehicle and working method
abstract: The invention discloses a design scheme of an amphibious vertical take-off and landing migration diving-probing unmanned aerial vehicle powered by solar energy, the unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a ship-shaped bottom fuselage, wings, an empennage, vehicle arms and a solar flexible cell panel, the bottom of the fuselage is a V-shaped fuselage bottom to meet the requirement of landing on the water surface, and meanwhile the unmanned aerial vehicle serves as an undercarriage in the ground take-off and landing stage; propellers are arranged on the vehicle arms and behind the vehicle body and are used for realizing take-off, landing and flight in the migration task of the unmanned aerial vehicle; the wings are installed on the rear portion of the fuselage in a penetrating mode, the wings are divided into inner-section wings and outer-section wings, solar panels are arranged on the upper surfaces of the inner-section wings and the outer-section wings, and the wingtip winglets are integrated with stable buoys needed by water surface take-off and landing. The diving detection unmanned aerial vehicle can vertically take off and land from the water surface or the land, has good transverse and longitudinal dampening and water floating stability, and can also guarantee high cruising speed and bird-imitating unlimited cruising ability.

title: Flying Power-Washing Drone
abstract: A drone cleaning apparatus includes a drone; and a pressure washer or power washer comprising a wand with nozzle, hose, and motor unit. The wand is fastened to an underside of the drone, with the hose attached to and connecting the wand and the motor unit. When the motor unit is turned on, a liquid jet emanates from the nozzle of the wand and may be directed onto a building for cleaning of the building. A method of making the drone cleaning apparatus, comprises: providing a drone and a pressure washer or power washer comprising a wand with nozzle, hose, and motor unit; attaching the wand to a bottom of the drone; and connecting the hose to the wand and to the motor unit.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle capable of releasing life ring
abstract: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle capable of releasing a life ring. The unmanned aerial vehicle structurally comprises an upper-end protecting shell, a midair indicator lamp, blades, four independent motors, a lower-end protecting shell, supporting legs, a mechanical pawl, a display, heat-dissipation holes, a camera, a safety soft cushion and a connecting limiting block, wherein the lower end of the upper-end protecting shell is in clearance fit with the upper end of the lower-end protecting shell; the four independent motors are mounted at four ends of the upper-end protecting shell; the lower ends of the blades are in screwed connection to the upper ends of the independent motors; the supporting legs are welded to the left side and the right side of the lower-end protecting shell; the upper end of the mechanical pawl is mechanically connected to the lower end of the middle of the lower-end protecting shell. The unmanned aerial vehicle has the advantages that the mechanical pawl is added at the lower end of the unmanned aerial vehicle and can carry the life ring in a rescue searching process, the life ring can be released when a drowning person is discovered, and accordingly the drowning person can be rescued, and rescuing efficiency is greatly improved.

title: ROTATING-WING DRONE, WITH INTRINSICALLY PROTECTIVE AND ACCIDENT PREVENTION SUPPORTING STRUCTURE
abstract: The invention relates to the structure of a rotating-wing drone (30), made of an expanded resin having a density of from 20 to 100 g/1, obtained through expansion of pre-expanded granules inside a mold. The structure comprises a supporting structure (20), a structure for protecting the propellers (35) and a base (22), as well as means (42,45) for fastening photographic equipment or the like.

title: Intelligent structural and spatial 3D realtime guidance and training security system that utilizes 3D models and 2D maps of facilities for training and to inform and guide authorities responding to emergencies
abstract: A security system configured to use three-dimensional (3D) scanning for security of buildings, locations, properties, or any other facility is disclosed. The use of 3D scanning by the security system allows authorities the ability to immediately download a 3D interactive model of any building, structure, property, or other facility. The security system is also configured to provide a link to a precise area of the 3D model which can be texted to police so they can actually see an approximate location of an assailant or perpetrator within the 3D model representation of an interior of the facility before they even enter it.

title: Cabin door connecting rod mechanism, cabin door assembly, unmanned aerial vehicle garage and vehicle
abstract: The invention relates to a cabin door connecting rod mechanism, a cabin door assembly, an unmanned aerial vehicle garage and a vehicle, the cabin door connecting rod mechanism is used for opening and closing a cabin door installed on the unmanned aerial vehicle garage, and the cabin door connecting rod mechanism comprises a first connecting rod and a second connecting rod, the base is suitable for being rotationally connected to the base of the unmanned aerial vehicle garage through a second hinge point F; the second connecting rod is suitable for being rotationally connected to the first connecting rod through a third hinge point C; the third connecting rod is suitable for being rotationally connected to the cabin door through a fourth hinge point B and is suitable for being rotationally connected to the base through a fifth hinge point G; wherein a first virtual connecting line AF is defined as a virtual line segment connected between the first hinge point A and the second hinge point F, and the orthographic projection of the third hinge point C on the first virtual connecting line is located between the midpoint M of the first virtual connecting line and the second hinge point F.

title: Battery-free unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles are provided. In one aspect, the unmanned aerial vehicle includes a four-bar linkage mechanism in mechanical communication with a pair of wings. An electrical subsystem includes an actuator in mechanical communication with the four-bar-linkage mechanism. The actuator is in electrical communication with a capacitor. A plurality of solar panels is in electrical communication with the capacitor, which is configured to harvest non-battery energy from the plurality of solar panels to power the actuator for controlling the four-bar linkage mechanism to operate the pair of wings.

title: Real-time automatic detection system for forest pest damage using drones
abstract: The present invention relates to a real-time automatic detection system for forest pest damage trees using an unmanned aerial vehicle, which can increase the continuity of work by integrating functions of drone operation, orthophotography production, damage tree detection, and damage tree information provision through one system, and more specifically, to a real-time automatic detection system for forest pest damage trees using an unmanned aerial vehicle, which can reduce manpower dependence and quickly obtain accurate information by enabling measurement and management even in a terrain or a wide forest area that is difficult to access by utilizing drones and artificial intelligence (AI), as well as continuously monitor forest pest prediction using drones, and can efficiently monitor forest pest damage trees through an automatic image analysis program.

title: FLYING BODY
abstract: [Problem] To obtain a flying body with enhanced flight attitude stability through ingenious modification of the layout of constituent parts. [Solution] This flying body includes: a plurality of propellers 101-1a to 101-4b; a plurality of propeller driving motors 102-1a to 102-4b that drive, so as to rotate, each of the plurality of propellers individually; and a frame formed by joining a plurality of support arms 10, 11, 12, 20, 21, and 22 that support the plurality of propeller driving motors. The flying body also includes a sensor for controlling the flight of the flying body. A rotation center P of the flying body for when attitude control is performed is located in an area enclosed by the plurality of propellers at a position farthest from each of the propeller driving motors, and the sensor is provided near the rotation center P.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle aileron mechanism and unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle aileron mechanisms. The unmanned aerial vehicle aileron mechanism comprises a steering engine connector arranged in a vehicle body, a wing assembly and a wing assembly, the rear aileron is connected to the rear side of the wing; one end of the aileron transmission shaft is connected with the rear aileron, and the other end of the aileron transmission shaft penetrates through the fuselage longitudinal beam, extends into the fuselage and is connected with the steering engine connector; the aileron transmission shaft comprises a connector, one end of which is fixedly connected to one side, close to the fuselage, of the rear aileron; one end of the aileron rotating shaft is fixed to the connector, the other end of the aileron rotating shaft penetrates through the fuselage longitudinal beam to be connected with the steering engine connector, and the aileron rotating shaft is connected with the fuselage longitudinal beam through a first bearing. The aileron rotating mechanism and the steering engine can be placed in the fuselage through the aileron transmission shaft, the designable space of the aileron rotating mechanism is increased, and the requirement and influence of the aileron rotating mechanism on the aerodynamic configuration are avoided. And the device has the advantages of simplicity in installation, convenience in disassembly, stable structure, short manufacturing period and the like.

title: Integrated multimode thermal energy transfer system, method and apparatus for clean fuel electric multirotor aircraft
abstract: An integrated multimode thermal energy transfer system, method and apparatus for full-scale clean fuel electric-powered multirotor aircraft with automatic on-board-capability to provide sensor-based temperature awareness and adjustment to critical components and zones of the aircraft. Automatic computer monitoring, including by a programmed triple-redundant digital autopilot computer, controls each motor-controller and motor to produce pitch, bank, yaw and elevation, while simultaneously measuring, calculating, and adjusting temperature and heat transfer of aircraft components and zones, to protect critical components from exceeding operating parameters and to provide a safe, comfortable environment for occupants during flight. By using the results of the measurements to inform computer monitoring, the methods and systems can use byproducts including thermal energy disparities and differentials related to both fuel supply systems and power generating systems to both add and remove heat from different aircraft zones to improve aircraft function, comfort, and efficiency.

title: Intelligent medical nursing system based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent medical nursing system based on an unmanned aerial vehicle. A hospitalization device comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle warehouse, a nursing unmanned aerial vehicle, a connecting mechanism, a medical ward bed and a hanging fixing mechanism, the nursing device comprises a nursing passage, a nursing telescopic motor, a nursing telescopic supporting column, amedical feeder and a flight mechanism, and the storage device comprises a liquid food storage chamber, a liquid food guiding tube, a liquid food pump and a liquid food pumping pipeline; a telescopic device comprises a ground telescopic passage, a ground telescopic motor and a ground telescopic plate, a fixed device comprises a ground fixed passage, a ground fixed motor, a ground fixed plate, an abutting telescopic plate and a telescopic abutting groove, and a sealing device comprises a telescopic sealing motor, a telescopic sealing plate, a fixed sealing motor and a fixed sealing plate; a recognition device comprises a first camera, a second camera, a flow controller and a temperature sensor, a wireless device is arranged in a control center, and the control center is arranged at a plannedposition.

title: SYSTEM FOR SPECIFYING DETECTION OBJECT POSITION
abstract: To provide a system for specifying a detection object position, that identifies a detection object from image data photographed using a drone 11, and specifies a position of the identified detection object as a height of a probability value.SOLUTION: In a system 10 for specifying a position of a detection object, multiple pieces of image data photographed by a drone 11 using a camera 14 are transmitted to an arithmetic unit 12, and the arithmetic unit 12 generates a set of probability cells of a region in which the drone 11 is flying, and then, artificial intelligence is utilized to obtain a detection likelihood of the detection object and a position and size of the detection object on the image data contained in the image data. Further, in the system for specifying a position of the detection object, an update object range in the probability cell set is specified on the basis of position information of the drone 11 and a photographing direction of the image data, and a probability value of each cell contained in the update object range is updated on the basis of the detection likelihood of the detection object and the position and size of the detection object on the image data, by using an updating numerical expression based on the Bayes' theorem. These procedures are carried out once or more in order to specify the detection object as a height of the probability value for each cell in the probability cell set.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: REMOTE OPERATED VEHICLE FOR CLEANING GRAIN BINS
abstract: In one or more arrangements, a system and method for cleaning a grain bin using a remote operated vehicle is presented. In one or more arrangements, the grain bin is emptied until the grain will no longer flow from the grain bin using conventional pumps and conveyors. In some arrangements, a remote operated vehicle is configured to be piloted through a door in a grain bin once grain has been removed from adjacent the door. In some arrangements, the remote operated vehicle has a foldable head assembly configured to fold and unfold to facilitate entry and removal of the remote operated vehicle through the door of the grain bin. In some arrangements, the remote operated vehicle is operably connected to a grain vacuum to facilitate removal of grain from the grain bin. In some arrangements, the remote operated vehicle can be remotely piloted to facilitate removal of grain.

title: Modular variable unmanned aerial vehicle system and delivery method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a modular variable unmanned aerial vehicle system and a delivery method thereof. The modular variable unmanned aerial vehicle system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle set composed of a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicle modules (1) and a plurality of tool platforms (2) carrying airborne computers. The unmanned aerial vehicle module (1) comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle (3), and an outer frame (4) is fixed to the periphery of the unmanned aerial vehicle (3). The peripheries of the outer frame (4) and the tool platform (2) are regular polygons; the tool platform (2) is connected with the unmanned aerial vehicle module (1) through a detachable structure; the unmanned aerial vehicle (3) and the tool platform (2) are each internally provided with a flight controlsystem. Each flight control system comprises an aerial docking recognition unit, an unmanned aerial vehicle combination stability keeping unit and a power management system. The aerial docking identification unit is used for the unmanned aerial vehicle to identify a detachable structure connection part on the tool platform (2); and the unmanned aerial vehicle combination stability maintaining unit is used for maintaining the flight stability of the unmanned aerial vehicle set when the unmanned aerial vehicle module (1) is assembled into or separated from the unmanned aerial vehicle set.

title: Nuclear radiation source finding system based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract: The invention provides a nuclear radiation source finding system based on an unmanned aerial vehicle. The nuclear radiation source finding system based on the unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle and a control platform. The multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle is internally provided with a radiation detector, a GPS positioning system, a controller and a wireless communication module; a flying route for the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle is planned by the control platform based on nuclear radiation accidents; the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle is controlled by the controller to fly at a nuclear radiation site according to the planned route, while flying, the radiation dosage at the current position is monitored in real time by a radiation detector, meanwhile the current position is located in real time by the GPS position system, and the radiation dosage and corresponded current position information are transmitted to the control platform by the controller through the wireless communication module in real time; the transmitted radiation dosage and the transmitted corresponding current position information are continuously received by the control platform, after the flying, current position information corresponding to the maximum radiation dosage is sieved out by the control platform from the received radiation dosage; The controller controls the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle to fly to the current position corresponding to the maximum value so as to conduct further source finding monitoring.

title: Vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle electric power inspection flight control method and system
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of data processing, are particularly relates to a vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle electric power inspection flight control method and vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle electric power inspection flight control system. By establishing a three-dimensional model and formulating an original inspection route through a route specifying module, anunmanned aerial vehicle management and control platform performs problem point identification on video or image information transmitted in real time in inspection, and formulates a temporary inspection route for a problem point; an unmanned aerial vehicle performs emphasized inspection on the problem point, so that errors caused by manual control are reduced, and the accuracy rate is improved; and when detecting that the humidity is too high, the wind power is too large or the electric quantity of the unmanned aerial vehicle is insufficient, the unmanned aerial vehicle management and controlplatform formulates a temporary route to recall the unmanned aerial vehicle for battery replacement or drying treatment, the failure rate is reduced, and the service life of the unmanned aerial vehicle is prolonged. The unmanned aerial vehicle is matched with the unmanned aerial vehicle management and control platform on an inspection vehicle, so that scientific management and control of electricpower inspection are realized, the service life of the unmanned aerial vehicle is prolonged, the fault probability is reduced, inspection is more automatic, the accuracy degree is improved, and the workload of people is reduced.

title: Multi-moving-body three-dimensional tracking and control platform based on visual sensor network
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-moving-body three-dimensional tracking and control platform based on a visual sensor network. The multi-moving-body three-dimensional tracking and control platform comprises four main modules including a multi-camera system, a ground control system, an airborne infrared reflective ball and a target unmanned aerial vehicle. The multi-camera system comprises a plurality of cameras with infrared filters, an infrared light supplement source for enhancing light intensity, a synchronous trigger for synchronizing image data of the plurality of cameras, and a navigation end computer for operating a core vision algorithm. Multiple cameras interact to form a visual sensor network. The ground control system receives navigation data from the multi-camera system and then uploads a control command to the target unmanned aerial vehicle through the wireless local area network. According to data transmission, navigation data are processed by utilizing a topic subscription and publishing mechanism of a robot operating system ROS, a control instruction for the unmanned aerial vehicle is calculated by combining a reference trajectory and a controller, and finally the instruction is published through a wireless local area network.

title: Efficient oblique photography image acquisition method, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of oblique photography, in particular to an efficient oblique photography image acquisition method. The method comprises the following steps that: geographic information data of a shooting area is acquired; navigation data is acquired, wherein the navigation data comprises unmanned aerial vehicle parameters and flight influence factors; whether the shooting area is a single terrain or a combined terrain is judged according to the geographic information data; under the condition that the shooting area is the combined terrain, the combined terrain is splitted into a plurality of single terrains; the heading overlapping degree and the lateral overlapping degree of shooting in each single terrain are calculated; flight parameters are calculated according to the heading overlapping degree, the lateral overlapping degree and the navigation data; and a shooting mode is determined, and an initial flight path is generated according to a shooting mode rule and the flight parameters. The geographic information data and the navigation data construct the shooting rule, so that the technical problems of poor quality and inaccuracy of shot images caused by human factors are solved, and the shooting quality and the shooting efficiency are improved.

title: Video monitoring method based on quantum encryption
abstract: The invention discloses a video monitoring method based on quantum encryption, and the method comprises the following steps: S2, enabling a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles to change the formation based on a current network state, and shooting an image of a current environment through a holder; S3, sending the shot current image to a central controller or storing the shot current image to storage modules of a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles; S4, enabling the central controller to control the display screen to display the current image, and controlling the plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles to attack the suspicious target based on the current image. S22, when each unmanned aerial vehicle collects the current transmission state x(k) of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the central processing unit and the transmission state of the unmanned aerial vehicle at the last moment in a certain area, sigma|x(k)| belongs to a threshold parameter of (0, 1), it is judged that network delay occurs in shooting of the unmanned aerial vehicles in the area, and multiple unmanned aerial vehicles are re-deployed at the moment kt + 1 to shoot the area. The invention mainly aims to provide a video monitoring method based on a quantum communication technology, and solves the problems of security vulnerabilities and potential safety hazards in the existing video monitoring technology.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle three-dimensional path planning method based on improved snake optimization algorithm
abstract: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle three-dimensional path planning method based on an improved snake optimization algorithm, and the method comprises the steps: setting corresponding parameters of an unmanned aerial vehicle based on the maximum safety range of a control variable and a state variable of the unmanned aerial vehicle; formulating a cost function based on the constraint of the three-dimensional path of the unmanned aerial vehicle, converting a path planning problem into a path optimization problem, and obtaining path fitness based on the path optimization problem; and on the basis of corresponding parameters of the unmanned aerial vehicle, based on an improved snake optimization algorithm, path fitness is selected, and an optimal path is obtained. In the snake optimization algorithm, the search range is limited, the generated random path node range is updated in real time, through the improvement, the search range is narrowed, meanwhile, the operand is reduced, the randomness is reduced, and the path node updating process of the algorithm is accelerated.

title: Unmanned agent cluster formation control method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle control, in particular to an unmanned agent cluster formation control method. Calculating an expected speed between adjacent numbered unmanned aerial vehicles through a distributed control algorithm; acquiring obstacle position data of an obstacle through acquisition equipment, and determining a collision time interval of the unmanned aerial vehicle; whether the unmanned aerial vehicle enters the collision area is determined according to the collision time interval, when the unmanned aerial vehicle enters the collision area, corresponding obstacle avoidance measures are started, a conflict-free and feasible multi-agent task planning solution is achieved, multiple agent cluster members sense the orientation of each other according to shared information in the movement process, automatic coordination is achieved, and the unmanned aerial vehicle collision avoidance method is suitable for the unmanned aerial vehicle. The safety distance between each other in the collaborative movement process is ensured, pace consistency is realized according to the cluster task, a favorable formation is formed, and the advantages of the unmanned cluster are played to a greater extent.

title: A wearable miniature UAV (unmanned aerial vehicle) system based on an internet of things
abstract: The invention discloses a wearable miniature UAV (unmanned aerial vehicle) system based on an internet of things, and relates to the technical field of IoT (internet of things) information. The UAV system comprises a detachable miniature UAV. The miniature UAV is provided with a flight control system, a camera assembly, a GPS positioning module and a wireless signal transmission module 1. The UAV system also comprises a smart wristband, which comprises a wristband body worn on an arm. The wristband body is internally provided with a master control module, a displayer, a 4G network communication module and a wireless signal transmission module 2. The wearable miniature UAV is exquisite and small; through the miniature UAV system, conventional UAV consumption experience is changed; and the UAV system not only has a flight function, but also has the functions of shooting, video chatting, human body health monitoring and music playing and like.

title: Hierarchical clustering network topology structure generation method based on multi-task unmanned aerial vehicle cluster information interaction
abstract: The invention discloses a hierarchical clustering network topology structure generation method based on multi-task unmanned aerial vehicle cluster information interaction. The method comprises the following steps: a step of determining an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster set and a position matrix of each cluster; a step of constructing a network topology structure of intra-cluster information interaction of each cluster; and a step of constructing a network topology structure of inter-cluster information interaction. According to the method, the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster is self-organizedby using the hierarchical clustering structure, and the mode of executing different tasks in different clusters is adopted, so that the problems that the scale of the unmanned aerial vehicle clusteris limited and information interaction only faces a single task are solved. Centralized control is adopted in a cluster in SCH topology of multi-task unmanned aerial vehicle cluster information interaction, a minimum spanning tree is calculated with a cluster head as a root to construct a network topology structure of any independent cluster, and therefore information interaction in all the independent clusters is completed. A spatial interaction gravitation model is introduced between the clusters to construct an inter-cluster network topology structure so as to complete information interaction between the unmanned aerial vehicle clusters.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle control method and device
abstract: An embodiment of the invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle control method and device. The method includes the steps: acquiring a first control command which is an original control command forcontrolling an unmanned aerial vehicle to fly in a target state; transforming the first control command to a second control command conforming to an expected response dynamic; acquiring flight state parameters of the unmanned aerial vehicle related to the second control command and accordingly generating comprehensive feedback; controlling errors according to the second control command and the comprehensive feedback to obtain a third control command; controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the third control command. Stability and robustness of the unmanned aerial vehicle control method are improved.

title: UNMANNED AERIAL VEHICLE CONTROL SYSTEM
abstract: The disclosure relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) control system (300, 400, 500), comprising: an air traffic control system (150) comprising at least one processor; and a plurality of UAVs (110, 120, 130) registered via a mobile network (140, 141, 142) with the air traffic control system (150), each (110) of the UAVs (110, 120, 130) comprising: a GNSS receiver (511) configured to receive location information (514) from at least one satellite (520) for indicating a location of the UAV (110); a wireless local area network (LAN) transceiver (513) configured to detect at least one nearby object (120) based on a wireless receive signal received from the at least one nearby object (120), the wireless receive signal comprising one of the following registration information (515): a registration number of the at least one nearby object (120), a faked registration number of the at least one nearby object (120) or a suppressed registration number of the at least one nearby object (120); and a mobile radio transceiver (512) configured to transmit the registration information (515) of the at least one nearby object (120) together with the location information (514) indicating the location of the UAV (110) to the air traffic control system (150), wherein the air traffic control system (150) is configured to detect an unknown object (121, 131) based on the registration information (515) and the location information (514) received from the plurality of UAVs (110, 120, 130).

title: Unmanned aircraft e.g. remote-controlled missile, controlling method, involves proportionally adding high-pass filtering signal to control signal, which is provided for controlling unit
abstract: The method involves subjecting a control signal given by a pilot to a high pass filtering, where the filtering does not concern a measuring signal that comes from a measuring instrument. The high-pass filtering signal is proportionally added to the control signal, which is provided for controlling a controlling unit. The filtering is effected, in which a difference between the control signal and an integrated signal is formed. Independent claims are also included for the following: (1) a data medium contains a program code provided for producing a merging process; and (2) an unmanned aircraft with a device for controlling the aircraft.

title: Communication method, device and equipment between automobile and unmanned aerial vehicle, and operating system
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a communication method, device and equipment between an automobile and an unmanned aerial vehicle and an operating system. The automobile is in wireless connection with the unmanned aerial vehicle. The method comprises the steps of receiving an operation instruction of a user; generating a control instruction corresponding to the operation instruction, wherein the control instruction is an instruction used for indicating the unmanned aerial vehicle to execute a flight task; sending the control instruction to the unmanned aerial vehicle which is used forexecuting the flight task according to the indication of the control instruction; and receiving information collected by the unmanned aerial vehicle in the process of executing the flight task. The flight safety of the vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle is improved, and the convenience of the user to control the unmanned aerial vehicle is enhanced.

title: Automated escort drone device, system and method
abstract: Embodiments of an escort drone device, system and method provide one or more autonomous or semi-autonomous escort drones capable of being summoned by an individual to a first location, wherein the escort drone(s) includes a payload with threat deterring components and wherein the threat deterring components can be engaged by a remote operator at a different location from the first location. In embodiments, the system can employ intelligent mesh networking to allocate one or more escort drones to one or more specific locations.

title: Method, device and equipment for processing landing position of unmanned aerial vehicle based on vision
abstract: The invention provides a vision-based unmanned aerial vehicle landing position processing method, device and equipment, which are used for conveniently, efficiently and accurately realizing fixed-point landing of an unmanned aerial vehicle through a novel landing mark designed by the application. The method for processing the landing position of the unmanned aerial vehicle based on vision comprises the steps that an initial image collected by the unmanned aerial vehicle is obtained, and the initial image is collected by the unmanned aerial vehicle through a camera device carried by the unmanned aerial vehicle; a landing mark contained in the initial image is recognized, the landing mark is configured in an entity mode, the pattern of the landing mark is composed of four layers of concentric squares, and adjacent connected domains in the pattern of the landing mark adopt different filling colors; determining the position of a landing mark; and dynamically adjusting the flight speed and direction of the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the position of the landing mark to guide the unmanned aerial vehicle to land autonomously.

title: C++ code generation method for unmanned aerial vehicle flight mode based on state machine diagram
abstract: The invention provides a C++ code generation method of an unmanned aerial vehicle flight mode based on a state machine diagram, for solving the problems of low efficiency of generating an unmanned aerial vehicle code and insufficient quality of the generated code due to the fact that a code generation method in the prior art is not attached to an unmanned aerial vehicle platform and lacks a code conversion method. The C++ code generation method comprises the following steps: formulating a work flow of each flight mode of the unmanned aerial vehicle flight control system; constructing a framework SysML state machine diagram of the unmanned aerial vehicle; constructing a sub SysML state machine diagram of the flight mode mi based on the framework SysML state machine diagram; obtaining an XMIfile of each flight mode mi; formulating a hierarchical code generation rule; and based on the hierarchical code generation rule, obtaining a C++ code of the unmanned aerial vehicle flight control system.

title: Planning method for cooperative obstacle avoidance of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles
abstract: The invention discloses a planning method for cooperative obstacle avoidance of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles, relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle planning, and aims to solve the problem that multiple unmanned aerial vehicles cannot efficiently complete cooperative tasks in an unknown and complex environment in the prior art. According to the method, the evaluation function set of the grids is designed based on the Fast Marching algorithm, conduction of simulation waves at unnecessary grids is reduced, the search speed of a global path can be increased, and the planning efficiency is improved; only the local trajectory is optimized, the motion smoothness of the unmanned aerial vehicle is ensured, an additional smooth filtering algorithm is not needed, compared with global trajectory optimization, the calculated amount is greatly reduced, the time cost can be saved to a great extent, and the real-time online planning requirement can be better met. According to the invention, the consistency of the sensing information and the guidance of the cooperative structure are combined, and the defects of insufficient flexibility and adaptability of a multi-unmanned-aerial-vehicle cooperative obstacle avoidance planning method in an unknown complex environment are overcome, so that the execution efficiency of a multi-unmanned-aerial-vehicle cooperative task in the unknown environment is effectively improved.

title: Method for repeatedly measuring and positioning geographic position of ground target by fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract: The invention discloses a method for measuring and positioning the geographic position of a ground target for multiple times by a fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicle. The fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicle executes an expected route task in a constant-speed and constant-height state; an image is shot through a pan-tilt camera on the fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicle, the image is monitored in real time, and if a target appears in the image and is not located in the central area of the image, an adjustment state is entered; when the target appears in the image and is located in the central area of the image, entering a positioning state, and controlling the pan-tilt camera on the fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicle to deflect according to the deviation between the central point of the target and the center of the image; after deflection processing, the optical axis of the pan-tilt camera points to the target, and according to the included angles of the pan-tilt camera relative to the fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicle in the pitching direction and the yawing direction, the two angles and the geographic information and height information of the fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicle, the geographic position information of the target relative to the fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicle is obtained through settlement processing. The method has the advantages that the principle is simple, the fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicle flight task is simple, and the outdoor ground target is positioned for multiple times.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle route dynamic planning method based on A* search
abstract: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle route dynamic planning method based on A* search, which is used for solving the technical problem that the existing method has poor adaptability for the situation that long-strip shaped polygonal threatening regions or no-fly zones exist in the complex environment.
