The unmanned aerial vehicle route dynamic planning method comprises the steps of: constructing circumscribed circles of polygonal threatening regions or no-fly zones at first, and judging whether a line segment formed by a starting point and a target point intersects with each polygonal circumscribed circle; further judging whether the line segment and the polygonal threatening regions or no-fly zones have an intersection point or not if the line segment intersects with the polygonal circumscribed circles; and if so, planning and generating a route directly avoiding the polygonal threatening regions or no-fly zones based on an A* search algorithm, wherein a dead zone escaping and two-step optimizing strategies is adopted during the route planning process for planning and generating route points in sequence. The unmanned aerial vehicle route dynamic planning method can adapt to the situation that the long-strip shaped polygonal threatening regions or no-fly zones exist in the complex environment, and can adapt to the situation that the circular or polygonal threatening regions or no-fly zones are overlapped with one another.

title: Flight prompting method, device, control terminal, system and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a flight prompt method, a device, control terminal (10), system and storage medium, the method comprising: displaying, on an interactive interface of the control terminal (10), an image transmission screen and/or a map screen captured by an unmanned aerial vehicle (20) (S101); acquiring obstacle information sensed by the unmanned aerial vehicle (20) (S102); and according to the obstacle information, displaying an obstacle prompt icon at a bounding box of the interactive interface (S103).

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle flight control method and device
abstract: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle flight control method and device, and relates to the technical field of aerospace. A specific embodiment of the method comprises the steps of receiving a control instruction sent by a ground controller, wherein the control instruction comprises target time and a preset relative position relative to a first unmanned aerial vehicle; receiving a first unmanned aerial vehicle real-time position corresponding to the target time sent by the first unmanned aerial vehicle; calculating the target position of the second unmanned aerial vehicle accordingto the real-time position of the first unmanned aerial vehicle and the relative position relative to the first unmanned aerial vehicle; and controlling the second unmanned aerial vehicle to fly to the target position of the second unmanned aerial vehicle. According to the embodiment, the accuracy of controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle by the ground controller is improved.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle anti-crash structure and anti-crash control system
abstract: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle anti-crash structure and an anti-crash control system. A machine vision device photographs, extracts coordinates, intelligently recognizes the coordinates and then sends the coordinates to a flight control system, the relative position of an unmanned aerial vehicle is determined by combining parameters such as the flight height and collision sensor induction, and whether the unmanned aerial vehicle is in a threat state or not is judged; after it is confirmed that the unmanned aerial vehicle is about to fall, an avoidance strategy is generated,the unmanned aerial vehicle is controlled to avoid crowds and houses and fly towards a soft zone, an electromagnetic buckle is started in the falling process, a movable door is opened, a parachute rushes out of a parachute box, the falling speed is decreased, a height sensor senses the height of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and before a vehicle body touches the ground, a lithium battery is powered off, and the magnetic block reduces magnetism; and meanwhile, an air generator inflates an air bag body, the air bag body pops out an air bag box to wrap the vehicle body, the unmanned aerial vehicle is protected during falling, the damage rate is reduced, and economic losses are reduced.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle control systembased on ant colony algorithm
abstract: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle control system based on an ant colony algorithm, thereby optimizing an express delivery path, improving the delivery efficiency, shortening the delivery time and optimizing an express delivery mode in a complex environment by using the ant colony algorithm. The unmanned aerial vehicle control system based on the ant colony algorithm comprises a data center, a terminal data distribution module, a terminal data receiving module and a terminal processor. The data center is used for sending a terminal control command and receiving feedback information; the terminal data receiving module is used for receiving the terminal control command and forwarding the terminal control command to the terminal processor; the terminal processor is used for receiving the terminal control command, generating node information and path information according to the terminal control command, integrating the node information and the path information into feedback information and sending the feedback information to the terminal data distribution module; and the terminal data distribution module is used for sending the feedback information to the data center.

title: CONTROLLER FOR CONTROLLING THE TRAJECTORY OF A QUADROTOR
abstract: Controller (1) for controlling the trajectory of a quadrotor (Q) provided with propellers (P), which comprises a closed loop whereby a control signal (u<sub>f</sub>) is fed to the thrust, the control signal (u<sub>f</sub>) being: uƒ=marB+RƒaB+mgB−Kpep−Kυeυ−ϕxA^ where:a<sub>r</sub> is the reference acceleration of the desired trajectory;e<sub>p</sub> = p - p<sub>r</sub> is the position tracking error;e<sub>v</sub> = v - v<sub>r</sub> is the velocity tracking term;Kp and Kv are positive definite control gain matrices for position and velocity respectively; f<sub>a</sub><sup>B</sup> are the modelled aerodynamic forces in the body frame;R is the body to inertial frame Rotation Matrix; such that the terms marB+RƒaB+mgB form the nominal model feedforward, K<sub>p</sub>e<sub>p</sub> - K<sub>v</sub>e<sub>v</sub> form the proportional feedback terms wherein φ(x)A are the unmodelled forces which form the feedback adaptation term that comprises the unmodeled forces, φ(x) is a Neural Network that is trained offline, and A is a latent variable that is adapted online; wherein φ(x) has been obtained through training of data corresponding to different propeller damage conditions.

title: UAV obstacle avoidance system and method based on interval flow field
abstract: The invention discloses a UAV obstacle avoidance system and a UAV obstacle avoidance method based on an interval flow field. The UAV obstacle avoidance system comprises a hardware module, a software module and a control module. The hardware module comprises a multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, a monocular camera, a Quad-core processor and a flight controller. The software module adopts an LK pyramid sparse optical flow obstacle avoidance algorithm, and distinguishes obstacles mainly based on optical flow intensities. The control module is mainly based on an ID identification form, and encodes in 8 directions separately. The UAV obstacle avoidance method comprises the steps that: the UAV obstacle avoidance system mainly adopts the monocular camera to obtain an image sequence in terms of hardware, adopts an Odroid U3 processor for processing, adopts a serial port to communicate with a Pixhawk flight control, then executes 8 control instructions for left, right, up, down, upper left, lower left, upper right and lower right obstacle avoidance. The avoidance algorithm adopts an LK pyramid sparse optical flow, divides a flow field into hierarchical upper, middle, lower, left, middle and right intervals, and compares flow fields of the 6 intervals with one another, so as to perform decision-making in the 8 directions.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle control method and device, unmanned aerial vehicle and system
abstract: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle control method and device, an unmanned aerial vehicle and a system, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles. The method comprises the steps that music information is collected; a control instruction is determined according to the music information; and an operation corresponding to the control instruction is carried out. According to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle can be controlled through music; the music control method is convenient and feasible; a user does not need to tediously control a ground terminal tosend the control instruction to the unmanned aerial vehicle; the music control method is novel and easy for the user to accept; and the user's control experience on the unmanned aerial vehicle is comprehensive improved.

title: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle global and local path intelligent planning method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle global and local path intelligent planning method and system. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a grid map, obtaining a global path planning model by using an improved bidirectional search A star algorithm, and carrying out global path planning; acquiring obstacle motion state information in the environment through a millimeter wave radar, and acquiring flight state information of the unmanned aerial vehicle; judging whether conflicts exist or not, designing a reward function, and generating a corresponding obstacle avoidance strategy; a state space and an action space are obtained, obstacle avoidance training is carried out by adopting a depth deterministic strategy gradient algorithm, the action of the unmanned aerial vehicle is controlled in a continuous action space, obstacles are avoided, a local path planning model is obtained, and a global navigation path is tracked; each unmanned aerial vehicle carries out path planning by using a global path planning model and a local path planning model at the same time; according to the invention, the flight path planning and obstacle avoidance efficiency of the multi-unmanned aerial vehicle system can be improved, the continuous action output of the multi-unmanned aerial vehicle can be controlled in a dynamic unknown complex environment, and all-weather working conditions are met.

title: Obstacle avoidance control method, device and unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract: The present invention discloses an obstacle avoidance control method, an obstacle avoidance control device and an unmanned aerial vehicle. The method comprises the following steps that: current environment brightness is determined; the current environment brightness is compared with a set brightness threshold value; a current obstacle avoidance mode is detected; if the current environment brightness is larger than or equal to the brightness threshold value, and the current obstacle avoidance mode is monocular structure optical obstacle avoidance, the current obstacle avoidance mode is switched to binocular vision obstacle avoidance; and if the current environment brightness is smaller than the set brightness threshold value, and the current obstacle avoidance mode is binocular vision obstacle avoidance, the current obstacle avoidance mode is switched to the monocular structure optical obstacle avoidance.

title: FLIGHT ROUTE DETERMINING SYSTEM, AND SERVER
abstract: The objective of the present invention is to determine a preferred flight route for a multi-purpose flying object. A flight route determining system S comprising a battery-driven drone 300 and a server 100 for managing the drone 300 is provided with: a selecting means 111 for selecting a target parking place 400 from among a plurality of parking places 400 corresponding to a plurality of destinations; a first setting means and a second setting means 112, 113 for setting a direct route for causing a drone 300a parked in the target parking place 400 to fly between a first destination and a second destination without passing through any parking places 400, and a detour route for causing the drone 300a to fly between the first destination and the second destination via a parking place 400; a first calculating means 114 for calculating a flyable distance on the basis of a load weight and a remaining battery capacity; and a first determining means 116 for determining, on the basis of the flyable distance, one of the direct route and the detour route as a flight route for the drone 300a.

title: Rapid linkage command system and method
abstract: The invention relates to a rapid linkage command system and method, the rapid linkage command system comprises an instruction issuing module, an aircraft for image acquisition and a streaming media player, the instruction issuing module comprises a geographic coordinate positioning module, a preset instruction database and an information transmission module, and the image acquisition aircraft comprises anaircraft control module and a propeller transmission module and an information receiving module electrically connected with the aircraft control module. Geographic position coordinates and some specific instructions in a database are transmitted to the receiving module of the aircraft through an instruction issuing module, and the aircraft is driven to perform image acquisition through theflight control module and the propeller transmission module. The flight height and route of each unmanned aerial vehicle are planned before execution, collision accidents caused by task execution ofmultiple unmanned aerial vehicles are avoided, the track and real-time position of each unmanned aerial vehicle are in a system map so that commanding and dispatching can be conducted at any time, instructions do not depend on characters or voices, and graphs are directly displayed on pictures so that understanding of operators can be facilitated.

title: OBSTACLE-AVOIDANCE DETECTION METHOD, MOVING APPARATUS, AND UNMANNED AERIAL VEHICLE
abstract: An obstacle-avoidance detection method, comprising the following steps: rotating a detection view field to a current movement direction or a preliminary movement direction (S1); detecting whether an obstacle exists in a space environment in the current movement direction or the preliminary movement direction, and stopping moving or avoiding the obstacle when it is detected that the obstacle exists (S2). By making the detection view field of an obstacle-avoidance detection apparatus rotatable and making the detection view field always face toward the current movement direction or the preliminary movement direction, an unmanned aerial device can move toward different directions without steering, and the detection view field can also always face toward the current movement direction or the preliminary movement direction of the unmanned aerial device, and therefore, the movement safety of the unmanned aerial device is better ensured.

title: Visual cluster formation control method for vertical take-off and landing fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and provides a visual cluster formation control method for vertical take-off and landing fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles,which comprises the following steps of: firstly, defining an expected geometrical relationship among the unmanned aerial vehicles by using a horizontal speed coordinate system of the unmanned aerial vehicles so as to enable the formation to adapt to maneuvering in any direction; carrying out unmanned aerial vehicle visual information measurement; converting the measured state information into a relative position vector under a north-east coordinate system, and estimating the relative state of the unmanned aerial vehicle; determinin an unmanned aerial vehicle formation flight mode according tothe unmanned aerial vehicle relative speed information, and adopting a hysteresis loop control mode to determine stable switching between unmanned aerial vehicle flight safety and an unmanned aerial vehicle formation state in a fixed wing mode; finally, generating formation control instructions. According to the invention, the dependence of unmanned aerial vehicle formation cooperation on communication, landing and takeoff conditions is reduced, and the flexibility and independence of formation cooperation control are improved.

title: Multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle tracking and intercepting method and system based on point cloud
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle safety, and particularly provides a multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle tracking and intercepting method and system based on point clouds, and the method comprises the following steps: collecting the three-dimensional space feature information of a multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, and building a control target background scene model; data which are repeated due to overlapping of the scanning ranges are removed; recognizing a dynamic scene changing around the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle; subtraction is carried out on the preprocessed data and an aerial target background scene model; and calculating three-dimensional coordinate information of the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, tracking the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle by an interception system according to the three-dimensional coordinate information, and carrying out path planning and attitude adjustment on the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle according to the ground environment background scene model data. According to the scheme, the invading multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle can be identified and tracked, and the invading multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle can be intercepted through a communication signal interference technology. According to the scheme, the unmanned aerial vehicle can be efficiently identified and intercepted, and low-altitude safety of a deployment area is guaranteed.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle safe landing method and device
abstract: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle safe landing method and device, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a current position image, and dividing the current position image intoa plurality of regions; according to the deep convolutional neural network model, identifying a safe region in the plurality of regions, and sorting confidence coefficients corresponding to the calculated safe region; and controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to fly to the position over the area with the highest confidence coefficient in the safe area, calculating the projection plane of the unmanned aerial vehicle in the area with the highest confidence coefficient, and controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to land on the projection plane, wherein the projection plane is a safe landing area. According to the unmanned aerial vehicle safe landing method provided by the embodiment of the invention, when the unmanned aerial vehicle needs emergency forced landing or the unmanned aerial vehicle finishes normal flight, safe landing can be performed according to the surrounding actual environment without depending on infrastructures such as a standby landing field, the cost is low, the unmanned aerial vehicle safe landing method can be applied to different airlines, and the expansibility is high.

title: Fine intelligent inspection device based on unmanned aerial vehicle technology
abstract: The invention provides a fine intelligent inspection device based on an unmanned aerial vehicle technology, and relates to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle cruising. The fine intelligent inspection device based on the unmanned aerial vehicle technology comprises a base station, a processing device and a display device are arranged in the base station, an unmanned aerial vehicle is arranged on the surface of the base station, a photographing part is arranged on the lower surface of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and a judgment module and an execution module are arranged in the unmanned aerial vehicle. Through semi-overlapped unmanned aerial vehicle distribution, abnormal data are subjected to bidirectional confirmation, judgment is more accurate, when an abnormity occurs, the abnormity is checked through the unmanned aerial vehicle, the speed of routing inspection of the whole area is not affected, routing inspection information delay and errors can be effectively reduced, routing inspection is more refined, a scheme reading module and an execution module are arranged in the processing device, so that abnormal conditions can be processed in time, generated delay is small, loss and damage are reduced, the device is more intelligent, and the workload of workers is reduced.

title: Method and system for realizing automatic routing inspection of fan blade power generation equipment by unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a system for realizing automatic routing inspection of fan blade power generation equipment by an unmanned aerial vehicle. The method comprises the following steps: collecting coordinate system data of the fan blade power generation equipment; calculating twelve flight waypoints of the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the coordinate system data; storing the flight waypoint data obtained by calculation as a KML (Keyboard Markup Language) file; and importing the KML file into flight software of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and executing flight. According to the method, an included angle psi between the axis of a fan hub and the north direction and an included angle gamma between fan blades and the longitudinal axis of a tower drum are obtained in an image processing mode by relying on a DJI latest flight platform longitude and latitude M300RTK and being provided with an upper holder and a lower holder, the size of the whole fan is known, and longitude and latitude height coordinates of the center point of the hub are obtained through a handheld RTK, 12 pieces of waypoint information can be generated through calculation; the full-autonomous flight task of the fan blade can be achieved, the fan only needs to be braked, and the fan blade does not need to be controlled to be in a Y shape.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle flight control method, device and equipment
abstract: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle flight control method comprising the following steps that movement information of an operating end is captured so that first data flow including the movement trajectory information of the operating end is generated; the first data flow is processed and converted into second data flow including flight control instructions corresponding to the movement trajectory information of the operating end; and the flight control instructions of the second data flow are responded and an unmanned aerial vehicle is indicated to complete flight motions having the same movement trajectory with that of the operating end. With application of the unmanned aerial vehicle flight control method, flight control of the unmanned aerial vehicle is enabled to be more visual, the operation difficulty of the unmanned aerial vehicle is greatly reduced and the human-computer interaction mode of the unmanned aerial vehicle is enabled to be simpler and more convenient.

title: Drone trajectory planning system
abstract: The invention discloses a drone trajectory planning system. The drone trajectory planning system comprises a drone module and a cloud platform module, wherein the drone module is used for collecting the flight trajectory information of a current drone and uploading the flight trajectory information to the cloud platform module; the cloud platform module is used for analyzing the received flight trajectory information and feeding back corresponding optimal trajectory planning information to the drone corresponding to the drone module. The drone trajectory planning system has the advantages that drone trajectory planning is separated from the drone, the drone trajectory planning is performed by the cloud platform module, the calculation and storage burden of the drone is relieved greatly, different drones can share one cloud platform module, the multiple drones can share resources in the cloud platform module, the repeated calculation of the trajectory planning is avoided, and drone trajectory planning efficiency is increased greatly.

title: Power command communication vehicle of unmanned aerial vehicle inspection equipment carrying centering mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses a power command communication vehicle of unmanned aerial vehicle inspection equipment carrying a centering mechanism. The power command communication vehicle comprises a vehicle body, a command communication vehicle server, a command communication vehicle integrated management system, an unmanned aerial vehicle integrated management system and a power supply integrated management system. The command communication vehicle server and the command communication vehicle integrated management system are used for communicating with a command center and sending and receiving instructions; the command communication vehicle integrated management system is in wireless connection with the unmanned aerial vehicle and is used for receiving and processing information transmitted by the unmanned aerial vehicle and processing the information; the unmanned aerial vehicle integrated management system is used for controlling the flight state of the unmanned aerial vehicle and controlling the centering mechanism; the power supply integrated management system is used for power supply and power supply management. Through the command communication vehicle integrated management system, corresponding instructions can be conveniently issued, and data can be conveniently collected and processed. By arranging the unmanned aerial vehicle comprehensive management system, automatic control over the unmanned aerial vehicle can be achieved, manual operation of a flying hand is not needed, control is convenient, and the operation cost is reduced.

title: Beidou agricultural insurance intelligent information system
abstract: The invention discloses a Beidou agricultural insurance intelligent information system which relates to the technical field of agricultural insurances. A Beidou navigation precise position service network is wirelessly connected with an unmanned aerial vehicle terminal and a personnel terminal. The unmanned aerial vehicle and the personnel terminal are wirelessly connected with an insurance accepting farmland geographical position data acquisition system. The insurance accepting farmland geographical position data acquisition system is wirelessly connected with a Beidou Yinong data processingcenter. The Beidou Yinong data processing center performs policy holder claim settlement processing, and realizes personnel and equipment scheduling. Data acquisition of an affected farmland is performed through a claim settlement person and the unmanned aerial vehicle. Furthermore the acquired data are manufactured for forming a DEM graph, and the data are transmitted to the Beidou Yinong data processing center. According to the Beidou agricultural insurance intelligent information system, automatic image filing is realized through transmitting to the system by means of a mobile network; theBeidou technology is utilized for acquiring spatial information of an area to which the insurance accepting land lot and a security are affiliated, thereby generating effective position information; and the working efficiency is maximally improved.

title: Suspended flight control method for quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicle based on partial feedback linearization
abstract: The invention relates to a control method for loaded flight of a quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicle, provides a nonlinear controller based on a partial feedback linearization method, and realizes well suppression for swinging of a suspended load in flight while realizing trajectory tracking for the quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicle. The technical invention adopted by the invention is that the suspended flight control method for the quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicle based on partial feedback linearization is implemented on an unmanned aerial vehicle provided with a suspending rope used for suspending an object. The suspended flight control method comprises the steps of building a nonlinear dynamic model, performing partial linearization on the nonlinear dynamic model of the suspended flight process of the quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicle by using the partial feedback linearization method, and thus designing a controller to realize control for the unmanned aerial vehicle. The suspended flight control method is mainly applied to loaded flight control occasions of the quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicle.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle system for line inspection and control method thereof
abstract: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle system for line inspection and a control method thereof. The system comprises a monitoring platform and an unmanned aerial vehicle body. The monitoring platform is in wireless connection with the unmanned aerial vehicle body, and the monitoring platform issues an inspection task to the unmanned aerial vehicle body and receives inspection information acquired by the unmanned aerial vehicle body. According to the invention, intelligent power transmission line inspection can be realized, and power service personnel can remotely control the unmanned aerial vehicle to perform real-time monitoring and defect pre-judgment on the operation condition of the power transmission line in the inspection area.

title: Photovoltaic power station unmanned aerial vehicle inspection system and control method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a photovoltaic power station unmanned aerial vehicle inspection system. The system comprises: an inspection unmanned aerial vehicle provided with a flight control module and apower module, a wireless communication module, a visible light camera and an infrared thermal imaging camera which are electrically connected with the flight control module; an unmanned aerial vehiclehangar provided with an inner cavity capable of accommodating the inspection unmanned aerial vehicle and a data transmission module, wherein the data transmission module can be in wireless communication with the wireless communication module; and an unmanned aerial vehicle management center comprising a data processing server and a terminal device, wherein the data processing server can communicate with the data transmission module, and the terminal equipment is provided with a display module. The photovoltaic power station unmanned aerial vehicle inspection system can know whether a photovoltaic panel breaks down or is damaged and can know the position of the photovoltaic panel according to the image information shot by the unmanned aerial vehicle and the corresponding flight information, so that maintainers can complete an inspection task without on-site control, and the inspection efficiency is improved.

title: Intelligent sunshine simulation system based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract: The invention belongs to the sunshine simulation technology field and especially relates to an intelligent sunshine simulation system based on an unmanned aerial vehicle. The simulation system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle sun simulation light source system, a work platform, intelligent terminal control equipment and a three-dimensional coordinate construction system. The unmanned aerial vehicle sun simulation light source system comprises one unmanned aerial vehicle. A sunshine simulation light source and a positioning calibration module are carried on a lower portion of the unmanned aerial vehicle. A wireless communication module and an intelligent control module are installed above the unmanned aerial vehicle. Latitude and longitude coordinates, date and time and other information of a simulation building location are input into the terminal control equipment, and a solar azimuth and a height angle at this moment can be automatically calculated. The unmanned aerial vehicle sun simulation light source system is controlled to arrive at an assigned position of an indoor three-dimensional coordinate system, and an irradiation angle of a light source is adjusted so as to realize sunshine simulation. The system is detachable and is easy to carry. Through using advantages of the unmanned aerial vehicle, construction of the system is flexible and is not limited by a place; and a sun trace is directly embodied and sunshine simulation is accurately realized. The system can be used for building energy saving research, building program designing and other fields.

title: PATROL METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR COOPERATIVE OPERATION OF UNMANNED AERIAL VEHICLE AND GROUND PATROL ROBOT
abstract: A patrol method and apparatus for cooperative operation of an unmanned aerial vehicle and a ground patrol robot. The method comprises: on the basis of position information of devices in a plant area and environmental elements of the plant area, determining an overhead patrol path and a ground patrol path (step 11); receiving first target information of a target device acquired by an unmanned aerial vehicle on the basis of the overhead patrol path, and receiving second target information of the target device acquired by a ground patrol robot on the basis of the ground patrol path (step 12); on the basis of the first target information and the second target information, acquiring operation state information of the target device (step 13); and on the basis of the operation state information and preset reference information, determining an operation state of the target device (step 14).

title: Blinding expelling method and system for black flight unmanned aerial vehicle, medium and product
abstract: The invention discloses a blinding expelling method and system for a black flight unmanned aerial vehicle, a medium and a product, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles. The method comprises the following steps: inputting the model, the surface reflectivity, the initial surface temperature, the real-time distance and the environment illumination intensity of a target black-flight unmanned aerial vehicle into a preset decision model, and obtaining the optimal laser wavelength and the initial laser power matched with the target black-flight unmanned aerial vehicle for expelling the target black-flight unmanned aerial vehicle; dynamically focusing the laser beam according to the real-time distance, aligning a light spot of the laser beam to a photosensitive element area of the target black-flight unmanned aerial vehicle, and monitoring the actual output power of the laser and the surface temperature of the target black-flight unmanned aerial vehicle in real time; the driving current of the laser is adjusted through the PID controller; and when the visual identification signal detects that the target black flight unmanned aerial vehicle is in the out-of-control state for a preset time length, laser beam emission is stopped. By implementing the technical scheme, the expelling efficiency and safety are improved.

title: Networking radar interference strategy generation method based on unmanned aerial vehicle group
abstract: The invention discloses a networking radar interference strategy generation method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle group, which is applied to the field of radar confrontation, and aims to solve the problem that when a traditional Euclidean distance method is utilized to design a return function in the prior art, the state change of an inert intelligent agent does not affect the total return due to the appearance of the inert intelligent agent. And the effect of reinforcement learning training is reduced. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, establishing a networking radar detection-unmanned aerial vehicle group cooperative interference game confrontation scene model, and designing a state space and an action space of the model; and then Euclidean distances of all radars and all unmanned aerial vehicles are calculated to form a matrix, the radars and the unmanned aerial vehicle group are matched by using a Hungary algorithm to obtain an index of a one-to-one correspondence relationship between each radar and each unmanned aerial vehicle, and the indexes are used to control the flight path of the unmanned aerial vehicle group, so that the final total control quantity of the unmanned aerial vehicle group is minimum. The problem of abnormal matching of the networking radar and the unmanned aerial vehicle group is effectively solved, and the training strategy of game confrontation of the networking radar and the unmanned aerial vehicle group is improved.

title: High-safety transformer substation inspection unmanned aerial vehicle system and method
abstract: The invention relates to a high-safety transformer substation inspection unmanned aerial vehicle system, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle and a ground measurement and control system, and is characterized in that the unmanned aerial vehicle is provided with a central control module, a navigation positioning module, an audible and visual alarm, an electromagnetic detection module and a plurality of UWB modules, a holder is arranged on an unmanned aerial vehicle bracket, and a visible light camera and an infrared thermal imager are arranged on the holder; the ground measurement and control system comprises a UWB positioning base station, a server and a monitoring computer. The visible light camera, the infrared thermal imager, the navigation positioning module, the audible and visual alarm, the electromagnetic detection module and the UWB module are respectively connected with the central control module; the UWB module and the UWB positioning base station adopt UWB communication; and the UWB positioning base station and the monitoring computer are respectively connected with the server. The invention further discloses an inspection method. The system is high in positioning precision and strong in anti-interference capability, achieves the automatic inspection of the transformer substation equipment, automatically stores the inspection information to the server, and is high in automation degree.
